reason: The first real Search Console impression is for the homepage. DigitalHut should treat the homepage as the umbrella doorway for the 200,572,944 longtail search-route universe, then route interested visitors into watch, category, blog, GLB, podcast/source, and analytics proof pages.

currentArtifactRead.meaning: Google has moved from only seeing the homepage into discovering the public proof artifacts and route shells. The next movement to watch is indexing, impressions, clicks, proof route opens, or source opens.

visibleQueryFamily.interpretation: Google is testing brand-adjacent language first. Cyberhut is not treated as a functionality win by itself; it is a weak homepage doorway until repeated with DigitalHut-branded or observatory-intent variants.
homepageVariationTargets: digital hut glb podcast source analytics
visibleQueryFamily.routingRule: Keep these variations anchored to the homepage because that is the indexed visible link, then route interested users into /watch/full-view-episode-alternative, /system-proof, and /master-keyword-coverage while benchmarking real functionality competitors separately.

homepageListingAngle.plainLanguage: video watching plus 3D Model View plus podcast/source moments plus live analytics in one full-screen entertainment observatory
homepageListingAngle.whyThisLinkMatters: The homepage is the link Google is already willing to show. It should carry the broad promise and then let proof routes carry specific longtail keyword variations.
homepageListingAngle.snippetGoal: A human seeing the homepage in search should immediately understand that DigitalHut is not a normal blog, not a plain video page, and not only a 3D viewer. It is a full entertainment/research interface.
